query: What sample sizes and monitoring durations are required to detect meaningful SOC changes given bulk-density and measurement variance?

response.query: What sample sizes and monitoring durations are required to detect meaningful SOC changes given bulk-density and measurement variance?
response.answer: To detect meaningful soil organic carbon changes, sample sizes and monitoring durations depend on variance and bulk density; typically, larger sample sizes and longer durations are needed for greater variance. Generally, at least 30 samples and annual monitoring over several years are recommended.

results.title: How to Monitor Streambank Erosion and Estimate Resulting ...
results.content: In the field, cross-sectional surveys or erosion pins are commonly used to measure bank retreat (Purvis and Fox 2016). Streambank erosion rates can be calculated using measured cross-sectional and top of bank (TOB) surveys with a total station. We recommend calculating the minimum, average, and maximum bank retreat values from the cross-section surveys to account for the uncertainty in measuring and quantifying streambank erosion rates and associated volumes. The area of erosion can then be multiplied by the height of the streambank obtained from the field measurement of the cross-section to generate a volume of total erosion that has occurred during the time between surveys. 2. For eroding banks without cross-sections, multiply the area of erosion from TOB surveys by the measured bank height. 3. To quantify the volume of erosion for the entire reach, sum the total volume of sediment for all eroded streambanks with measured cross-sections and TOB surveys.

results.title: Federal Register :: Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) Program
results.content: Docket Title | Document ID | Comments || Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) Program: Standards for 2026 and 2027, Partial Waiver of 2025 Cellulosic Biofuel Volume Requirement, and Other Changes | [EPA-HQ-OAR-2024-0505-0002](https://www.regulations.gov/document/EPA-HQ-OAR-2024-0505-0002) | [1,986](https://www.regulations.gov/document/EPA-HQ-OAR-2024-0505-0002/comment) |  |. In this action, EPA is proposing the volume targets and applicable percentage standards for cellulosic biofuel, BBD, advanced biofuel, and total renewable fuel for 2026 and 2027.[[1](#footnote-1-p25785)]  We are also proposing a number of regulatory changes, including reducing the number of RINs generated for imported renewable fuel and renewable fuel produced from foreign feedstocks and removing renewable electricity as a qualifying renewable fuel under the RFS program (commonly referred to as eRINs). EPA is requesting comment on multiple aspects of this action, including the proposed volume requirements, our technical analyses supporting those volumes, our proposal to reduce the number of RINs generated for imported renewable fuels and renewable fuels produced from foreign feedstocks, the removal of renewable electricity as a qualifying renewable fuel under RFS program, and the other proposed regulatory amendments.
